title: Homo Verificans
logline: The Audit of Heaven — twenty-eight faiths run through four axioms (S: a record must be distinguishable from no record; B: recording requires irreversibility; R: records accumulate forward; C: no record is fully isolated), each tradition given the same four-part audit and a named kill-switch test: the evidence that would have falsified its core claim, if it existed.
market: narrative nonfiction / comparative religion, systematic audit format — Book II of the Homo Ter Probatus trilogy
source: Migrated 2026-08-31: no manuscript source survives in any local repo (press, platform, klaus, lucid-rodeo) — only the author-supplied print PDF and EPUB. ~129,000 words, 16 chapters per the trilogy summary found alongside Homo Credens' source.
notes: Book II of the Homo Ter Probatus box set (~410,000 words total across Credens/Verificans/Benignus). Premise: 'at least one record exists' — the same one-liner as the 420 Code itself.
